items.followUp: State the rules for writing the scientific name of an organism using binomial nomenclature.

rubric.why: Binomial nomenclature gives each species a name made of two parts.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for explaining that it is a two-part scientific naming system consisting of the genus and specific name.

rubric.why: The genus name comes first and begins with a capital letter.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that the genus is written first and starts with a capital letter.

rubric.why: The specific name follows the genus and begins with a lowercase letter.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that the second name is the specific name and starts with a lowercase letter.

rubric.why: Scientific names are Latin or latinized and follow standard formatting conventions.
rubric.description: State the language or formatting convention.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that the names are Latin or latinized and italicized in print, or that each word is underlined separately when handwritten.

modelAnswer: Binomial nomenclature is the system of giving each species a two-word scientific name: the genus name followed by the specific name.
The genus name is written first and begins with a capital letter.
The specific name is written second and begins with a lowercase letter.
The names are Latin or latinized and are italicized in print; when handwritten, each word is underlined separately.

items.followUp: Give two ways that fish farming can help increase fish production.

rubric.why: Fish farms and hatcheries raise fish under managed conditions and can increase production.
rubric.description: Suggest developing fish farms or hatcheries.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for mentioning fish farming, aquaculture, fish farms or hatcheries.

rubric.why: Better fish-rearing practices and protection of fish stocks and habitats support greater production.
rubric.description: Give another suitable improvement to fisheries.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for one suitable measure, such as improved rearing methods, suitable feed, or protecting fish and their habitats from pollution or overfishing.

modelAnswer: Develop fish farms and hatcheries to raise more fish.
Use improved fish-rearing methods and suitable feed, and protect fish habitats from pollution and overfishing.
